en: How many songs have I listened to in total?
How many plays do I have overall?
What's my total number of listens?
it: Quanti ascolti ho in totale?
Quante canzoni ho ascoltato in tutto?
Qual è il numero totale dei miei ascolti?

computed.en: Counted plays across the whole archive.
computed.it: Ascolti conteggiati in tutto l'archivio.

sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS plays FROM listens WHERE counted = 1

en: How many plays did I have in {year}?
How many songs did I listen to in {year}?
Total listens in {year}
it: Quanti ascolti ho fatto nel {year}?
Quante canzoni ho ascoltato nel {year}?
Ascolti totali del {year}

computed.en: Counted plays in {year}.
computed.it: Ascolti conteggiati nel {year}.

sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS plays FROM listens WHERE counted = 1 AND local_year = {year}

en: And in {year2}?
What about {year2}?
it: E nel {year2}?
E invece nel {year2}?

en: How many songs did I play in {month_en} {year}?
Plays in {month_en} {year}
it: Quanti brani ho ascoltato a {month_it} {year}?
Ascolti di {month_it} {year}

computed.en: Counted plays in {month_en} {year}.
computed.it: Ascolti conteggiati a {month_it} {year}.

sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS plays FROM listens WHERE counted = 1 AND local_year = {year} AND local_month = {month}

en: How many songs did I listen to on {date_en}?
Plays on {date}
it: Quante canzoni ho ascoltato il {date_it}?
Ascolti del {date}

computed.en: Counted plays on {date}.
computed.it: Ascolti conteggiati il {date}.

sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS plays FROM listens WHERE counted = 1 AND local_date = '{date}'

en: How many songs have I listened to today?
How many plays today?
it: Quante canzoni ho ascoltato oggi?
Quanti ascolti oggi?

computed.en: Counted plays on {today}.
computed.it: Ascolti conteggiati il {today}.

sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS plays FROM listens WHERE counted = 1 AND local_date = '{today}'

en: How many songs did I listen to yesterday?
Plays yesterday
it: Quante canzoni ho ascoltato ieri?
Ascolti di ieri

computed.en: Counted plays on {yesterday}.
computed.it: Ascolti conteggiati il {yesterday}.

sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS plays FROM listens WHERE counted = 1 AND local_date = '{yesterday}'

en: How many songs did I listen to in the last {days} days?
Plays over the past {days} days
it: Quante canzoni ho ascoltato negli ultimi {days} giorni?
Ascolti degli ultimi {days} giorni

computed.en: Counted plays from {days_ago} through {today}.
computed.it: Ascolti conteggiati dal {days_ago} al {today}.

sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS plays FROM listens WHERE counted = 1 AND local_date >= '{days_ago}' AND local_date <= '{today}'

en: How many plays this month?
How much have I listened this month in plays?
it: Quanti ascolti questo mese?
Quante canzoni ho ascoltato questo mese?

computed.en: Counted plays from {this_month_start} through {today}.
computed.it: Ascolti conteggiati dal {this_month_start} al {today}.

sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS plays FROM listens WHERE counted = 1 AND local_date >= '{this_month_start}' AND local_date <= '{today}'

en: How many songs did I listen to last month?
Plays last month
it: Quante canzoni ho ascoltato il mese scorso?
Ascolti del mese scorso

computed.en: Counted plays from {last_month_start} to {last_month_end}.
computed.it: Ascolti conteggiati dal {last_month_start} al {last_month_end}.

sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS plays FROM listens WHERE counted = 1 AND local_date >= '{last_month_start}' AND local_date <= '{last_month_end}'

en: How many songs have I listened to this week?
Plays this week
it: Quante canzoni ho ascoltato questa settimana?
Ascolti di questa settimana

computed.en: Counted plays in the calendar week starting {this_week_start}.
computed.it: Ascolti conteggiati nella settimana iniziata il {this_week_start}.

sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS plays FROM listens WHERE counted = 1 AND week_date = '{this_week_start}'

en: How many plays do I have this year?
How many songs have I listened to so far this year?
it: Quanti ascolti ho quest'anno?
Quante canzoni ho ascoltato finora quest'anno?

computed.en: Counted plays in {this_year} through {today}.
computed.it: Ascolti conteggiati nel {this_year} fino al {today}.

sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS plays FROM listens WHERE counted = 1 AND local_year = {this_year}

en: How many songs did I listen to last year?
Plays last year
it: Quante canzoni ho ascoltato l'anno scorso?
Ascolti dell'anno scorso

computed.en: Counted plays in {last_year}.
computed.it: Ascolti conteggiati nel {last_year}.

sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS plays FROM listens WHERE counted = 1 AND local_year = {last_year}

en: How many times did I listen to {artist}?
How many plays does {artist} have?
Plays of {artist}
it: Quante volte ho ascoltato {artist}?
Quanti ascolti ha {artist}?
Ascolti di {artist}

computed.en: Counted plays for artist {artist} across all time.
computed.it: Ascolti conteggiati dell'artista {artist} in tutto il periodo.

sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) AS plays FROM listens l JOIN track_artists ta ON ta.track_id = l.track_id JOIN artists a ON a.id = ta.artist_id WHERE l.counted = 1 AND LOWER(a.name) = LOWER('{artist}')

en: How many times did I listen to {artist} in {year}?
{artist} plays in {year}
it: Quante volte ho ascoltato {artist} nel {year}?
Ascolti di {artist} nel {year}

computed.en: Counted plays for artist {artist} in {year}.
computed.it: Ascolti conteggiati dell'artista {artist} nel {year}.

sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) AS plays FROM listens l JOIN track_artists ta ON ta.track_id = l.track_id JOIN artists a ON a.id = ta.artist_id WHERE l.counted = 1 AND LOWER(a.name) = LOWER('{artist}') AND l.local_year = {year}

en: And in {year2}?
it: E nel {year2}?

en: How much have I listened to {artist} in the last {days} days?
{artist} plays in the past {days} days
it: Quanto ho ascoltato {artist} negli ultimi {days} giorni?
Ascolti di {artist} negli ultimi {days} giorni

computed.en: Counted plays for {artist} from {days_ago} through {today}.
computed.it: Ascolti conteggiati di {artist} dal {days_ago} al {today}.

sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) AS plays FROM listens l JOIN track_artists ta ON ta.track_id = l.track_id JOIN artists a ON a.id = ta.artist_id WHERE l.counted = 1 AND LOWER(a.name) = LOWER('{artist}') AND l.local_date >= '{days_ago}' AND l.local_date <= '{today}'

en: How many times did I listen to {track} by {track_artist}?
Plays of {track} by {track_artist}
it: Quante volte ho ascoltato {track} di {track_artist}?
Ascolti di {track} di {track_artist}

computed.en: Counted plays of {track} by {track_artist}, all editions together.
computed.it: Ascolti conteggiati di {track} di {track_artist}, tutte le edizioni insieme.

sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) AS plays FROM listens l JOIN tracks t ON t.id = l.track_id JOIN track_artists ta ON ta.track_id = t.id JOIN artists a ON a.id = ta.artist_id WHERE l.counted = 1 AND LOWER(t.title) = LOWER('{track}') AND LOWER(a.name) = LOWER('{track_artist}')

en: How many plays does the album {album} have?
How many times did I listen to songs from {album}?
it: Quanti ascolti ha l'album {album}?
Quante volte ho ascoltato brani di {album}?

computed.en: Counted plays of tracks on the album {album}.
computed.it: Ascolti conteggiati dei brani dell'album {album}.

sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS plays FROM listens l JOIN tracks t ON t.id = l.track_id JOIN albums al ON al.id = t.album_id WHERE l.counted = 1 AND LOWER(al.name) = LOWER('{album}')

en: How much time have I spent listening to music?
Total listening time
How long have I listened in total?
it: Quanto tempo ho passato ad ascoltare musica?
Tempo di ascolto totale
Quanto ho ascoltato in totale come tempo?

computed.en: Sum of known listening time of counted plays.
computed.it: Somma del tempo di ascolto noto degli ascolti conteggiati.

sql: SELECT SUM(listened_ms) AS listened_ms FROM listens WHERE counted = 1

en: How many hours did I listen in {year}?
Listening time in {year}
it: Quante ore ho ascoltato nel {year}?
Tempo di ascolto nel {year}

computed.en: Known listening time of counted plays in {year}.
computed.it: Tempo di ascolto noto degli ascolti conteggiati nel {year}.

sql: SELECT SUM(listened_ms) AS listened_ms FROM listens WHERE counted = 1 AND local_year = {year}

en: And in {year2}?
it: E nel {year2}?

en: How much time have I spent listening to {artist}?
Listening time for {artist}
it: Quanto tempo ho passato ad ascoltare {artist}?
Tempo di ascolto di {artist}

computed.en: Known listening time of counted plays by {artist}.
computed.it: Tempo di ascolto noto degli ascolti conteggiati di {artist}.

sql: SELECT SUM(l.listened_ms) AS listened_ms FROM listens l WHERE l.counted = 1 AND l.id IN (SELECT l2.id FROM listens l2 JOIN track_artists ta ON ta.track_id = l2.track_id JOIN artists a ON a.id = ta.artist_id WHERE LOWER(a.name) = LOWER('{artist}'))

en: How much of my listening time is actual measured playback?
Actual listening time only
it: Quanto del mio tempo di ascolto è riproduzione effettiva misurata?
Solo tempo di ascolto effettivo

computed.en: Listening time of counted plays whose duration is actual.
computed.it: Tempo di ascolto degli ascolti conteggiati con durata effettiva.

sql: SELECT SUM(listened_ms) AS listened_ms FROM listens WHERE counted = 1 AND duration_kind = 'actual'

en: How many plays have actual, estimated or unknown duration?
Break down my plays by duration kind
it: Quanti ascolti hanno durata effettiva, stimata o sconosciuta?
Dividi i miei ascolti per tipo di durata

computed.en: Counted plays grouped by duration kind.
computed.it: Ascolti conteggiati raggruppati per tipo di durata.

sql: SELECT duration_kind, COUNT(*) AS plays FROM listens WHERE counted = 1 GROUP BY duration_kind ORDER BY plays DESC, duration_kind ASC

en: How many of my plays have no known duration?
Plays with unknown listening time
it: Quanti ascolti non hanno una durata nota?
Ascolti con tempo di ascolto sconosciuto

computed.en: Counted plays whose duration is unknown.
computed.it: Ascolti conteggiati con durata sconosciuta.

sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS plays FROM listens WHERE counted = 1 AND duration_kind = 'unknown'

en: How many plays were shorter than 30 seconds?
How many short plays below the threshold do I have?
it: Quanti ascolti sono durati meno di 30 secondi?
Quanti ascolti sotto soglia ho?

computed.en: Plays below the 30-second threshold (not counted).
computed.it: Ascolti sotto la soglia dei 30 secondi (non conteggiati).

sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS short_plays FROM listens WHERE counted = 0

en: How many play attempts did I make in {year}, including short ones?
All records in {year}, counted or not
it: Quanti tentativi di ascolto ho fatto nel {year}, compresi quelli brevi?
Tutti i record del {year}, conteggiati o no

computed.en: Every listen in {year}, counted and below threshold.
computed.it: Tutti gli ascolti del {year}, conteggiati e sotto soglia.

sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS attempts FROM listens WHERE local_year = {year}

en: Who are my top {n} artists?
Top {n} artists of all time
My {n} most played artists
it: Quali sono i miei {n} artisti più ascoltati?
Top {n} artisti di sempre
I miei {n} artisti più ascoltati

computed.en: Top {n} artists by counted plays across all time.
computed.it: I {n} artisti con più ascolti conteggiati di sempre.

sql: SELECT a.name AS artist, COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) AS plays FROM listens l JOIN track_artists ta ON ta.track_id = l.track_id JOIN artists a ON a.id = ta.artist_id WHERE l.counted = 1 GROUP BY a.id ORDER BY plays DESC, a.name ASC LIMIT {n}

en: Top {n} artists in {year}
Who did I listen to most in {year}?
it: Top {n} artisti del {year}
Chi ho ascoltato di più nel {year}?

computed.en: Top {n} artists by counted plays in {year}.
computed.it: I {n} artisti con più ascolti conteggiati nel {year}.

sql: SELECT a.name AS artist, COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) AS plays FROM listens l JOIN track_artists ta ON ta.track_id = l.track_id JOIN artists a ON a.id = ta.artist_id WHERE l.counted = 1 AND l.local_year = {year} GROUP BY a.id ORDER BY plays DESC, a.name ASC LIMIT {n}

en: And in {year2}?
Same for {year2}
it: E nel {year2}?
Lo stesso per il {year2}

en: Top {n} artists by listening time
Which {n} artists have I spent the most time on?
it: Top {n} artisti per tempo di ascolto
Su quali {n} artisti ho passato più tempo?

computed.en: Top {n} artists by known listening time of counted plays.
computed.it: I {n} artisti con più tempo di ascolto noto.

sql: WITH per_artist AS (SELECT DISTINCT a.id AS artist_id, a.name AS name, l.id AS listen_id, l.listened_ms AS ms FROM listens l JOIN track_artists ta ON ta.track_id = l.track_id JOIN artists a ON a.id = ta.artist_id WHERE l.counted = 1) SELECT name AS artist, SUM(ms) AS listened_ms FROM per_artist GROUP BY artist_id ORDER BY listened_ms DESC, name ASC LIMIT {n}

en: My top {n} artists in the last {days} days
Who have I listened to most over the past {days} days?
it: I miei {n} artisti più ascoltati negli ultimi {days} giorni
Chi ho ascoltato di più negli ultimi {days} giorni?

computed.en: Top {n} artists by counted plays from {days_ago} through {today}.
computed.it: I {n} artisti con più ascolti dal {days_ago} al {today}.

sql: SELECT a.name AS artist, COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) AS plays FROM listens l JOIN track_artists ta ON ta.track_id = l.track_id JOIN artists a ON a.id = ta.artist_id WHERE l.counted = 1 AND l.local_date >= '{days_ago}' AND l.local_date <= '{today}' GROUP BY a.id ORDER BY plays DESC, a.name ASC LIMIT {n}

en: What are my top {n} songs?
Top {n} tracks of all time
My {n} most played tracks
it: Quali sono le mie {n} canzoni più ascoltate?
Top {n} brani di sempre
I miei {n} brani più ascoltati

computed.en: Top {n} tracks by counted plays across all time.
computed.it: I {n} brani con più ascolti conteggiati di sempre.

sql: SELECT t.title AS track, (SELECT a.name FROM track_artists ta JOIN artists a ON a.id = ta.artist_id WHERE ta.track_id = t.id ORDER BY ta.ordinal LIMIT 1) AS artist, COUNT(*) AS plays FROM listens l JOIN tracks t ON t.id = l.track_id WHERE l.counted = 1 GROUP BY t.id ORDER BY plays DESC, t.title ASC LIMIT {n}

en: Top {n} tracks in {year}
Which songs did I play most in {year}?
it: Top {n} brani del {year}
Quali canzoni ho ascoltato di più nel {year}?

computed.en: Top {n} tracks by counted plays in {year}.
computed.it: I {n} brani con più ascolti conteggiati nel {year}.

sql: SELECT t.title AS track, COUNT(*) AS plays FROM listens l JOIN tracks t ON t.id = l.track_id WHERE l.counted = 1 AND l.local_year = {year} GROUP BY t.id ORDER BY plays DESC, t.title ASC LIMIT {n}

en: And in {year2}?
it: E nel {year2}?

en: What are my top {n} songs by {artist}?
Most played {artist} tracks
it: Quali sono le mie {n} canzoni più ascoltate di {artist}?
Brani di {artist} più ascoltati

computed.en: Top {n} tracks credited to {artist} by counted plays.
computed.it: I {n} brani di {artist} con più ascolti conteggiati.

sql: SELECT t.title AS track, COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) AS plays FROM listens l JOIN tracks t ON t.id = l.track_id JOIN track_artists ta ON ta.track_id = t.id JOIN artists a ON a.id = ta.artist_id WHERE l.counted = 1 AND LOWER(a.name) = LOWER('{artist}') GROUP BY t.id ORDER BY plays DESC, t.title ASC LIMIT {n}

en: What are my top {n} albums?
Top {n} albums of all time
it: Quali sono i miei {n} album più ascoltati?
Top {n} album di sempre

computed.en: Top {n} albums by counted plays of their tracks.
computed.it: I {n} album con più ascolti conteggiati dei loro brani.

sql: SELECT al.name AS album, COUNT(*) AS plays FROM listens l JOIN tracks t ON t.id = l.track_id JOIN albums al ON al.id = t.album_id WHERE l.counted = 1 GROUP BY al.id ORDER BY plays DESC, al.name ASC LIMIT {n}

en: What are my top {n} albums by listening time in {year}?
Albums I spent the most time on in {year}
it: Quali sono i miei {n} album con più tempo di ascolto nel {year}?
Gli album su cui ho passato più tempo nel {year}

computed.en: Top {n} albums by known listening time of counted plays in {year}.
computed.it: I {n} album con più tempo di ascolto noto nel {year}.

sql: SELECT al.name AS album, SUM(l.listened_ms) AS listened_ms FROM listens l JOIN tracks t ON t.id = l.track_id JOIN albums al ON al.id = t.album_id WHERE l.counted = 1 AND l.local_year = {year} GROUP BY al.id ORDER BY listened_ms DESC, al.name ASC LIMIT {n}

en: Which albums by {artist} have I listened to?
List {artist}'s albums I played, most played first
it: Quali album di {artist} ho ascoltato?
Elenca gli album di {artist} che ho ascoltato, dal più ascoltato

computed.en: Albums whose main artist is {artist}, with counted plays.
computed.it: Album con {artist} come artista principale, con gli ascolti conteggiati.

sql: SELECT al.name AS album, COUNT(l.id) AS plays FROM albums al JOIN album_artists aa ON aa.album_id = al.id JOIN artists a ON a.id = aa.artist_id JOIN tracks t ON t.album_id = al.id JOIN listens l ON l.track_id = t.id AND l.counted = 1 WHERE LOWER(a.name) = LOWER('{artist}') GROUP BY al.id ORDER BY plays DESC, al.name ASC

en: Who are the main artists of the album {album}?
Whose album is {album}?
it: Chi sono gli artisti principali dell'album {album}?
Di chi è l'album {album}?

computed.en: Primary album artists of {album} in credit order.
computed.it: Artisti principali dell'album {album} in ordine di credito.

sql: SELECT a.name AS artist FROM albums al JOIN album_artists aa ON aa.album_id = al.id JOIN artists a ON a.id = aa.artist_id WHERE LOWER(al.name) = LOWER('{album}') ORDER BY aa.ordinal ASC, a.name ASC

en: Who is credited on {track}?
Which artists perform {track}?
it: Chi è accreditato su {track}?
Quali artisti interpretano {track}?

computed.en: Artists credited on {track}, in credit order.
computed.it: Artisti accreditati su {track}, in ordine di credito.

sql: SELECT DISTINCT a.name AS artist FROM tracks t JOIN track_artists ta ON ta.track_id = t.id JOIN artists a ON a.id = ta.artist_id WHERE LOWER(t.title) = LOWER('{track}') ORDER BY a.name ASC

en: How many plays do I have of songs where {artist} is a featured artist?
Plays of tracks featuring {artist} but not led by them
it: Quanti ascolti ho di brani in cui {artist} è ospite?
Ascolti di brani con {artist} come featuring

computed.en: Counted plays of tracks where {artist} is credited but not first.
computed.it: Ascolti conteggiati di brani in cui {artist} è accreditato ma non per primo.

sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) AS plays FROM listens l JOIN track_artists ta ON ta.track_id = l.track_id JOIN artists a ON a.id = ta.artist_id WHERE l.counted = 1 AND ta.ordinal > 0 AND LOWER(a.name) = LOWER('{artist}')

en: Which songs with more than one artist have I listened to most?
Top {n} collaborations
it: Quali brani con più di un artista ho ascoltato di più?
Top {n} collaborazioni

computed.en: Tracks credited to two or more artists, by counted plays.
computed.it: Brani accreditati a due o più artisti, per ascolti conteggiati.

sql: SELECT t.title AS track, COUNT(*) AS plays FROM listens l JOIN tracks t ON t.id = l.track_id WHERE l.counted = 1 AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM track_artists ta WHERE ta.track_id = t.id) > 1 GROUP BY t.id ORDER BY plays DESC, t.title ASC LIMIT {n}

en: How many different artists have I listened to?
Number of distinct artists I've played
it: Quanti artisti diversi ho ascoltato?
Numero di artisti distinti ascoltati

computed.en: Distinct artists with at least one counted play.
computed.it: Artisti distinti con almeno un ascolto conteggiato.

sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ta.artist_id) AS artists FROM listens l JOIN track_artists ta ON ta.track_id = l.track_id WHERE l.counted = 1

en: How many different songs did I listen to in {year}?
Distinct songs in {year}
it: Quanti brani diversi ho ascoltato nel {year}?
Canzoni distinte nel {year}

computed.en: Distinct songs (editions together) with counted plays in {year}.
computed.it: Brani distinti (edizioni insieme) con ascolti conteggiati nel {year}.

sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT t.edition_key) AS songs FROM listens l JOIN tracks t ON t.id = l.track_id WHERE l.counted = 1 AND l.local_year = {year}

en: How many different albums have I listened to?
Number of distinct albums I've played
it: Quanti album diversi ho ascoltato?
Numero di album distinti ascoltati

computed.en: Distinct albums with at least one counted play.
computed.it: Album distinti con almeno un ascolto conteggiato.

sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT t.album_id) AS albums FROM listens l JOIN tracks t ON t.id = l.track_id WHERE l.counted = 1 AND t.album_id IS NOT NULL

en: How many plays are of tracks with no album?
Plays of songs without an album
it: Quanti ascolti sono di brani senza album?
Ascolti di canzoni senza album

computed.en: Counted plays of tracks whose album is unknown.
computed.it: Ascolti conteggiati di brani con album sconosciuto.

sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS plays FROM listens l JOIN tracks t ON t.id = l.track_id WHERE l.counted = 1 AND t.album_id IS NULL

en: Which editions of {track} have I played?
On which releases did I listen to {track}?
it: Quali edizioni di {track} ho ascoltato?
Da quali uscite ho ascoltato {track}?

computed.en: Counted plays of {track} grouped by release.
computed.it: Ascolti conteggiati di {track} raggruppati per uscita.

sql: SELECT COALESCE(al.name, 'Unknown album') AS album, COUNT(*) AS plays FROM listens l JOIN tracks t ON t.id = l.track_id LEFT JOIN albums al ON al.id = t.album_id WHERE l.counted = 1 AND LOWER(t.title) = LOWER('{track}') GROUP BY t.id ORDER BY plays DESC, album ASC

en: What are the {n} longest songs I've listened to?
Longest tracks in my archive
it: Quali sono i {n} brani più lunghi che ho ascoltato?
Brani più lunghi del mio archivio

computed.en: Tracks with a known length, longest first.
computed.it: Brani con durata nota, dal più lungo.

sql: SELECT t.title AS track, t.duration_ms AS duration_ms FROM tracks t WHERE t.duration_ms IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM listens l WHERE l.track_id = t.id AND l.counted = 1) ORDER BY t.duration_ms DESC, t.title ASC LIMIT {n}

en: How long is my average listen?
Average listening time per play
it: Quanto dura in media un mio ascolto?
Tempo medio di ascolto per brano

computed.en: Average known listening time per counted play.
computed.it: Tempo di ascolto medio noto per ascolto conteggiato.

sql: SELECT CAST(AVG(listened_ms) AS INTEGER) AS average_ms FROM listens WHERE counted = 1 AND listened_ms IS NOT NULL

en: When did I first listen to {artist}?
When did I discover {artist}?
it: Quando ho ascoltato {artist} per la prima volta?
Quando ho scoperto {artist}?

computed.en: Earliest date with a counted play of {artist}.
computed.it: Prima data con un ascolto conteggiato di {artist}.

sql: SELECT MIN(l.local_date) AS first_play FROM listens l JOIN track_artists ta ON ta.track_id = l.track_id JOIN artists a ON a.id = ta.artist_id WHERE l.counted = 1 AND LOWER(a.name) = LOWER('{artist}')

en: When did I last listen to {artist}?
Last time I played {artist}
it: Quando ho ascoltato {artist} l'ultima volta?
Ultimo ascolto di {artist}

computed.en: Most recent counted play of {artist}.
computed.it: Ascolto conteggiato più recente di {artist}.

sql: SELECT MAX(l.played_at_ms) AS last_play FROM listens l JOIN track_artists ta ON ta.track_id = l.track_id JOIN artists a ON a.id = ta.artist_id WHERE l.counted = 1 AND LOWER(a.name) = LOWER('{artist}')

en: When exactly did I first play {track} by {track_artist}?
First time I heard {track} by {track_artist}, with the time
it: Quando esattamente ho ascoltato per la prima volta {track} di {track_artist}?
Prima volta che ho sentito {track} di {track_artist}, con l'ora

computed.en: Local date and time of the earliest counted play of {track} by {track_artist}.
computed.it: Data e ora locali del primo ascolto conteggiato di {track} di {track_artist}.

sql: SELECT MIN(l.played_at_local) AS first_play FROM listens l JOIN tracks t ON t.id = l.track_id JOIN track_artists ta ON ta.track_id = t.id JOIN artists a ON a.id = ta.artist_id WHERE l.counted = 1 AND LOWER(t.title) = LOWER('{track}') AND LOWER(a.name) = LOWER('{track_artist}')

en: What were the last {n} songs I listened to?
Show my {n} most recent plays
it: Quali sono le ultime {n} canzoni che ho ascoltato?
Mostra i miei {n} ascolti più recenti

computed.en: The {n} most recent counted plays.
computed.it: Gli {n} ascolti conteggiati più recenti.

sql: SELECT t.title AS track, l.played_at_ms AS played_at FROM listens l JOIN tracks t ON t.id = l.track_id WHERE l.counted = 1 ORDER BY l.played_at_ms DESC, l.id DESC LIMIT {n}

en: How many days passed between my first and last {artist} play?
Span of days I've been listening to {artist}
it: Quanti giorni sono passati tra il primo e l'ultimo ascolto di {artist}?
Da quanti giorni ascolto {artist}?

computed.en: Days between the first and last counted play of {artist}.
computed.it: Giorni tra il primo e l'ultimo ascolto conteggiato di {artist}.

sql: SELECT CAST(julianday(MAX(l.local_date)) - julianday(MIN(l.local_date)) AS INTEGER) AS days FROM listens l JOIN track_artists ta ON ta.track_id = l.track_id JOIN artists a ON a.id = ta.artist_id WHERE l.counted = 1 AND LOWER(a.name) = LOWER('{artist}')

en: On how many days did I listen to music in {year}?
How many days in {year} had at least one play?
it: In quanti giorni ho ascoltato musica nel {year}?
Quanti giorni del {year} hanno almeno un ascolto?

computed.en: Distinct days with a counted play in {year}.
computed.it: Giorni distinti con un ascolto conteggiato nel {year}.

sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT local_date) AS days FROM listens WHERE counted = 1 AND local_year = {year}

en: How many days in {year} did I not listen to anything?
Days without music in {year}
it: In quanti giorni del {year} non ho ascoltato nulla?
Giorni senza musica nel {year}

computed.en: Calendar days of {year} in the archive range without a counted play.
computed.it: Giorni del {year} nell'archivio senza ascolti conteggiati.

sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS days FROM calendar c WHERE c.year = {year} AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM listens l WHERE l.local_date = c.local_date AND l.counted = 1)

en: What's the longest stretch of days I went without listening to music?
Longest break from music in days
it: Qual è il periodo più lungo in cui non ho ascoltato musica?
Pausa più lunga dalla musica in giorni

computed.en: Longest run of consecutive calendar days without counted plays.
computed.it: Serie più lunga di giorni consecutivi senza ascolti conteggiati.

sql: WITH silent AS (SELECT c.local_date AS day FROM calendar c WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM listens l WHERE l.local_date = c.local_date AND l.counted = 1)), runs AS (SELECT day, julianday(day) - ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY day) AS grp FROM silent) SELECT COALESCE(MAX(run_length), 0) AS longest_gap_days FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS run_length FROM runs GROUP BY grp)

en: What is my longest daily listening streak?
Most consecutive days with music
it: Qual è la mia serie più lunga di giorni consecutivi di ascolto?
Il maggior numero di giorni di fila con musica

computed.en: Longest run of consecutive days with at least one counted play.
computed.it: Serie più lunga di giorni consecutivi con almeno un ascolto conteggiato.

sql: WITH days AS (SELECT DISTINCT local_date AS day FROM listens WHERE counted = 1), runs AS (SELECT day, julianday(day) - ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY day) AS grp FROM days) SELECT MAX(run_length) AS longest_streak FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS run_length FROM runs GROUP BY grp)

en: What's my longest streak of consecutive days listening to {artist}?
Most days in a row I played {artist}
it: Qual è la serie più lunga di giorni consecutivi in cui ho ascoltato {artist}?
Massimo di giorni di fila con {artist}

computed.en: Longest run of consecutive days with a counted play of {artist}.
computed.it: Serie più lunga di giorni consecutivi con un ascolto conteggiato di {artist}.

sql: WITH days AS (SELECT DISTINCT l.local_date AS day FROM listens l JOIN track_artists ta ON ta.track_id = l.track_id JOIN artists a ON a.id = ta.artist_id WHERE l.counted = 1 AND LOWER(a.name) = LOWER('{artist}')), runs AS (SELECT day, julianday(day) - ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY day) AS grp FROM days) SELECT MAX(run_length) AS longest_streak FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS run_length FROM runs GROUP BY grp)

en: On which day did I listen to the most music?
My busiest listening day ever
it: In quale giorno ho ascoltato più musica?
Il mio giorno con più ascolti di sempre

computed.en: Day with the most counted plays.
computed.it: Giorno con più ascolti conteggiati.

sql: SELECT local_date AS day, COUNT(*) AS plays FROM listens WHERE counted = 1 GROUP BY local_date ORDER BY plays DESC, local_date ASC LIMIT 1

en: How many plays did I have each year?
Plays per year
it: Quanti ascolti ho fatto ogni anno?
Ascolti per anno

computed.en: Counted plays grouped by year.
computed.it: Ascolti conteggiati raggruppati per anno.

sql: SELECT CAST(local_year AS TEXT) AS year, COUNT(*) AS plays FROM listens WHERE counted = 1 GROUP BY local_year ORDER BY local_year ASC

en: Show my plays month by month in {year}
Monthly plays in {year}
it: Mostra i miei ascolti mese per mese nel {year}
Ascolti mensili del {year}

computed.en: Counted plays per month in {year}.
computed.it: Ascolti conteggiati per mese nel {year}.

sql: SELECT printf('%d-%02d', local_year, local_month) AS month, COUNT(*) AS plays FROM listens WHERE counted = 1 AND local_year = {year} GROUP BY local_month ORDER BY local_month ASC

en: How did my listening time for {artist} change month by month in {year}?
{artist} listening time per month in {year}
it: Come è cambiato mese per mese il tempo di ascolto di {artist} nel {year}?
Tempo di ascolto di {artist} per mese nel {year}

computed.en: Known listening time of counted {artist} plays per month in {year}.
computed.it: Tempo di ascolto noto degli ascolti di {artist} per mese nel {year}.

sql: WITH plays AS (SELECT DISTINCT l.id, l.local_year, l.local_month, l.listened_ms FROM listens l JOIN track_artists ta ON ta.track_id = l.track_id JOIN artists a ON a.id = ta.artist_id WHERE l.counted = 1 AND l.local_year = {year} AND LOWER(a.name) = LOWER('{artist}')) SELECT printf('%d-%02d', local_year, local_month) AS month, SUM(listened_ms) AS listened_ms FROM plays GROUP BY local_month ORDER BY local_month ASC

en: How many plays per week did I have in {month_en} {year}?
Weekly plays in {month_en} {year}
it: Quanti ascolti a settimana ho fatto a {month_it} {year}?
Ascolti settimanali di {month_it} {year}

computed.en: Counted plays grouped by calendar week in {month_en} {year}.
computed.it: Ascolti conteggiati per settimana a {month_it} {year}.

sql: SELECT week_date AS week, COUNT(*) AS plays FROM listens WHERE counted = 1 AND local_year = {year} AND local_month = {month} GROUP BY week_date ORDER BY week_date ASC

en: Which days of the week do I listen to the most music?
Plays by day of the week
it: In quali giorni della settimana ascolto più musica?
Ascolti per giorno della settimana

computed.en: Counted plays grouped by weekday, Monday first.
computed.it: Ascolti conteggiati per giorno della settimana, dal lunedì.

sql: SELECT CASE weekday WHEN 1 THEN 'Monday' WHEN 2 THEN 'Tuesday' WHEN 3 THEN 'Wednesday' WHEN 4 THEN 'Thursday' WHEN 5 THEN 'Friday' WHEN 6 THEN 'Saturday' ELSE 'Sunday' END AS weekday, COUNT(*) AS plays FROM listens WHERE counted = 1 GROUP BY listens.weekday ORDER BY listens.weekday ASC

en: How many songs do I listen to on {weekday_en}s?
Plays on {weekday_en}s
it: Quante canzoni ascolto di {weekday_it}?
Ascolti del {weekday_it}

computed.en: Counted plays on {weekday_en}s.
computed.it: Ascolti conteggiati di {weekday_it}.

sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS plays FROM listens WHERE counted = 1 AND weekday = {weekday}

en: What percentage of my listening happens on weekends?
Share of plays on Saturday and Sunday
it: Che percentuale dei miei ascolti avviene nel weekend?
Quota di ascolti di sabato e domenica

computed.en: Percentage of counted plays on Saturday or Sunday.
computed.it: Percentuale di ascolti conteggiati di sabato o domenica.

sql: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN weekday IN (6, 7) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 1) AS weekend_percent FROM listens WHERE counted = 1

en: At what time of day do I listen to music?
Plays by hour of the day
it: A che ora del giorno ascolto musica?
Ascolti per ora del giorno

computed.en: Counted plays grouped by local hour.
computed.it: Ascolti conteggiati raggruppati per ora locale.

sql: SELECT local_hour AS hour, COUNT(*) AS plays FROM listens WHERE counted = 1 GROUP BY local_hour ORDER BY local_hour ASC

en: How many songs do I listen to between midnight and 5 am?
Late-night plays
it: Quante canzoni ascolto tra mezzanotte e le 5?
Ascolti notturni

computed.en: Counted plays starting between 00:00 and 04:59 local time.
computed.it: Ascolti conteggiati iniziati tra le 00:00 e le 04:59 locali.

sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS plays FROM listens WHERE counted = 1 AND local_hour BETWEEN 0 AND 4

en: How many plays started at {hour}:00?
How many songs did I start in the {hour} o'clock hour?
it: Quanti ascolti sono iniziati alle {hour}?
Quante canzoni ho fatto partire nell'ora delle {hour}?

computed.en: Counted plays starting in local hour {hour}.
computed.it: Ascolti conteggiati iniziati nell'ora locale {hour}.

sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS plays FROM listens WHERE counted = 1 AND local_hour = {hour}

en: At what hour do I usually listen to {artist}?
When in the day do I play {artist} the most?
it: A che ora ascolto di solito {artist}?
In che momento della giornata ascolto di più {artist}?

computed.en: Local hour with the most counted plays of {artist}.
computed.it: Ora locale con più ascolti conteggiati di {artist}.

sql: SELECT l.local_hour AS hour, COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) AS plays FROM listens l JOIN track_artists ta ON ta.track_id = l.track_id JOIN artists a ON a.id = ta.artist_id WHERE l.counted = 1 AND LOWER(a.name) = LOWER('{artist}') GROUP BY l.local_hour ORDER BY plays DESC, l.local_hour ASC LIMIT 3

en: On which kinds of device do I listen to music?
Plays by device type
Phone, computer or speaker: where do I listen most?
it: Su quali tipi di dispositivo ascolto musica?
Ascolti per tipo di dispositivo
Telefono, computer o speaker: dove ascolto di più?

computed.en: Counted plays grouped by known device type.
computed.it: Ascolti conteggiati raggruppati per tipo di dispositivo noto.

sql: SELECT device_type, COUNT(*) AS plays FROM listens WHERE counted = 1 AND device_type IS NOT NULL GROUP BY device_type ORDER BY plays DESC, device_type ASC

en: How many songs did I listen to on my {device_type_en}?
Plays from the {device_type_en}
it: Quante canzoni ho ascoltato dal {device_type_it}?
Ascolti dal {device_type_it}

computed.en: Counted plays with device type {device_type}.
computed.it: Ascolti conteggiati con tipo di dispositivo {device_type}.

sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS plays FROM listens WHERE counted = 1 AND device_type = '{device_type}'

en: How much time did I listen on my {device_type_en} in {year}?
Listening time on {device_type_en} in {year}
it: Quanto tempo ho ascoltato dal {device_type_it} nel {year}?
Tempo di ascolto da {device_type_it} nel {year}

computed.en: Known listening time of counted plays on device type {device_type} in {year}.
computed.it: Tempo di ascolto noto con tipo di dispositivo {device_type} nel {year}.

sql: SELECT SUM(listened_ms) AS listened_ms FROM listens WHERE counted = 1 AND device_type = '{device_type}' AND local_year = {year}

en: Which platforms do I use to listen?
Plays per platform (Android, iOS, Windows, ...)
it: Quali piattaforme uso per ascoltare?
Ascolti per piattaforma (Android, iOS, Windows, ...)

computed.en: Counted plays grouped by known platform.
computed.it: Ascolti conteggiati raggruppati per piattaforma nota.

sql: SELECT platform, COUNT(*) AS plays FROM listens WHERE counted = 1 AND platform IS NOT NULL GROUP BY platform ORDER BY plays DESC, platform ASC

en: How many songs did I play on {platform_en}?
Plays from {platform_en}
it: Quante canzoni ho ascoltato su {platform_it}?
Ascolti da {platform_it}

computed.en: Counted plays on platform {platform}.
computed.it: Ascolti conteggiati sulla piattaforma {platform}.

sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS plays FROM listens WHERE counted = 1 AND platform = '{platform}'

en: Who do I listen to most on {platform_en}?
Top {n} artists on {platform_en}
it: Chi ascolto di più su {platform_it}?
Top {n} artisti su {platform_it}

computed.en: Top {n} artists by counted plays on platform {platform}.
computed.it: I {n} artisti con più ascolti sulla piattaforma {platform}.

sql: SELECT a.name AS artist, COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) AS plays FROM listens l JOIN track_artists ta ON ta.track_id = l.track_id JOIN artists a ON a.id = ta.artist_id WHERE l.counted = 1 AND l.platform = '{platform}' GROUP BY a.id ORDER BY plays DESC, a.name ASC LIMIT {n}

en: On which devices do I listen to {artist}?
{artist} plays by device type
it: Su quali dispositivi ascolto {artist}?
Ascolti di {artist} per tipo di dispositivo

computed.en: Counted plays of {artist} grouped by known device type.
computed.it: Ascolti conteggiati di {artist} per tipo di dispositivo noto.

sql: SELECT l.device_type, COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) AS plays FROM listens l JOIN track_artists ta ON ta.track_id = l.track_id JOIN artists a ON a.id = ta.artist_id WHERE l.counted = 1 AND l.device_type IS NOT NULL AND LOWER(a.name) = LOWER('{artist}') GROUP BY l.device_type ORDER BY plays DESC, l.device_type ASC

en: Show the exact device names Spotify recorded
List the raw Spotify platform strings with their plays
it: Mostra i nomi esatti dei dispositivi registrati da Spotify
Elenca le stringhe piattaforma originali di Spotify con gli ascolti

computed.en: Counted plays grouped by the raw Spotify platform string.
computed.it: Ascolti conteggiati per stringa piattaforma originale di Spotify.

sql: SELECT device, COUNT(*) AS plays FROM listens WHERE counted = 1 AND device IS NOT NULL GROUP BY device ORDER BY plays DESC, device ASC LIMIT 50

en: In which countries have I listened to music?
Plays by country
it: In quali paesi ho ascoltato musica?
Ascolti per paese

computed.en: Counted plays grouped by known connection country.
computed.it: Ascolti conteggiati per paese di connessione noto.

sql: SELECT country, COUNT(*) AS plays FROM listens WHERE counted = 1 AND country IS NOT NULL GROUP BY country ORDER BY plays DESC, country ASC

en: How many songs did I listen to while in {country_en}?
Plays from {country_en}
it: Quante canzoni ho ascoltato mentre ero in {country_it}?
Ascolti registrati in {country_it}

computed.en: Counted plays with connection country {country}.
computed.it: Ascolti conteggiati con paese di connessione {country}.

sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS plays FROM listens WHERE counted = 1 AND country = '{country}'

en: On which days did I listen to music outside {country_en}?
Days I was streaming from abroad (not {country_en})
it: In quali giorni ho ascoltato musica fuori da {country_it}?
Giorni in cui ascoltavo dall'estero (non {country_it})

computed.en: Days with counted plays from a known country other than {country}.
computed.it: Giorni con ascolti conteggiati da un paese noto diverso da {country}.

sql: SELECT local_date AS day, country, COUNT(*) AS plays FROM listens WHERE counted = 1 AND country IS NOT NULL AND country <> '{country}' GROUP BY local_date, country ORDER BY local_date ASC, country ASC

en: What percentage of my plays were on shuffle?
How often do I use shuffle?
it: Che percentuale dei miei ascolti era in shuffle?
Quanto spesso uso la riproduzione casuale?

computed.en: Percentage of counted plays with known shuffle state that were shuffled.
computed.it: Percentuale degli ascolti conteggiati con stato shuffle noto riprodotti in shuffle.

sql: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(shuffle) / COUNT(*), 1) AS shuffle_percent FROM listens WHERE counted = 1 AND shuffle IS NOT NULL

en: How many {artist} plays were on shuffle?
Shuffled plays of {artist}
it: Quanti ascolti di {artist} erano in shuffle?
Ascolti in riproduzione casuale di {artist}

computed.en: Counted plays of {artist} with shuffle on.
computed.it: Ascolti conteggiati di {artist} con shuffle attivo.

sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) AS plays FROM listens l JOIN track_artists ta ON ta.track_id = l.track_id JOIN artists a ON a.id = ta.artist_id WHERE l.counted = 1 AND l.shuffle = 1 AND LOWER(a.name) = LOWER('{artist}')

en: How many songs did I skip in {year}?
Skipped plays in {year}
it: Quante canzoni ho saltato nel {year}?
Brani saltati nel {year}

computed.en: Plays Spotify marked as skipped in {year}, counted or not.
computed.it: Ascolti segnati da Spotify come saltati nel {year}, conteggiati o no.

sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS skipped FROM listens WHERE skipped = 1 AND local_year = {year}

en: Which songs do I skip the most?
Top {n} most skipped tracks
it: Quali canzoni salto più spesso?
I {n} brani più saltati

computed.en: Tracks with the most plays marked as skipped.
computed.it: Brani con più ascolti segnati come saltati.

sql: SELECT t.title AS track, COUNT(*) AS skips FROM listens l JOIN tracks t ON t.id = l.track_id WHERE l.skipped = 1 GROUP BY t.id ORDER BY skips DESC, t.title ASC LIMIT {n}

en: What is my skip rate for {artist}?
How often do I skip {artist}?
it: Qual è la mia percentuale di skip per {artist}?
Quanto spesso salto {artist}?

computed.en: Share of {artist} plays with known skip state that were skipped.
computed.it: Quota degli ascolti di {artist} con stato skip noto che sono stati saltati.

sql: WITH p AS (SELECT DISTINCT l.id, l.skipped FROM listens l JOIN track_artists ta ON ta.track_id = l.track_id JOIN artists a ON a.id = ta.artist_id WHERE l.skipped IS NOT NULL AND LOWER(a.name) = LOWER('{artist}')) SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(skipped) / COUNT(*), 1) AS skip_percent FROM p

en: How many songs did I listen to offline?
Offline plays
it: Quante canzoni ho ascoltato offline?
Ascolti offline

computed.en: Counted plays made in offline mode.
computed.it: Ascolti conteggiati fatti in modalità offline.

sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS plays FROM listens WHERE counted = 1 AND offline = 1

en: Which songs do I play most offline?
Top {n} offline tracks
it: Quali canzoni ascolto di più offline?
Top {n} brani ascoltati offline

computed.en: Tracks with the most counted offline plays.
computed.it: Brani con più ascolti conteggiati offline.

sql: SELECT t.title AS track, COUNT(*) AS plays FROM listens l JOIN tracks t ON t.id = l.track_id WHERE l.counted = 1 AND l.offline = 1 GROUP BY t.id ORDER BY plays DESC, t.title ASC LIMIT {n}

en: How do my songs usually start playing?
Plays by reason they started
it: Come partono di solito le mie canzoni?
Ascolti per motivo di avvio

computed.en: Counted plays grouped by known start reason.
computed.it: Ascolti conteggiati raggruppati per motivo di avvio noto.

sql: SELECT reason_start, COUNT(*) AS plays FROM listens WHERE counted = 1 AND reason_start IS NOT NULL GROUP BY reason_start ORDER BY plays DESC, reason_start ASC

en: Why do my songs usually stop?
Plays by reason they ended
it: Perché si fermano di solito le mie canzoni?
Ascolti per motivo di fine

computed.en: All plays grouped by known end reason.
computed.it: Tutti gli ascolti raggruppati per motivo di fine noto.

sql: SELECT reason_end, COUNT(*) AS plays FROM listens WHERE reason_end IS NOT NULL GROUP BY reason_end ORDER BY plays DESC, reason_end ASC

en: How many plays started because {reason_start_en}?
Count the songs that started because {reason_start_en}
it: Quanti ascolti sono partiti perché {reason_start_it}?
Conta i brani partiti perché {reason_start_it}

computed.en: Counted plays with start reason {reason_start}.
computed.it: Ascolti conteggiati con motivo di avvio {reason_start}.

sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS plays FROM listens WHERE counted = 1 AND reason_start = '{reason_start}'

en: How many plays ended because {reason_end_en}?
How often did a song stop because {reason_end_en}?
it: Quanti ascolti sono finiti perché {reason_end_it}?
Quante volte un brano si è fermato perché {reason_end_it}?

computed.en: All plays with end reason {reason_end}.
computed.it: Tutti gli ascolti con motivo di fine {reason_end}.

sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS plays FROM listens WHERE reason_end = '{reason_end}'

en: What percentage of songs do I listen to until the end?
How often do I finish a track?
it: Che percentuale di canzoni ascolto fino alla fine?
Quanto spesso finisco un brano?

computed.en: Share of plays with a known end reason that ended with trackdone.
computed.it: Quota degli ascolti con motivo di fine noto terminati con trackdone.

sql: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN reason_end = 'trackdone' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 1) AS completed_percent FROM listens WHERE reason_end IS NOT NULL

en: Which artists do I pick by hand most often?
Top {n} artists I chose myself from a list
it: Quali artisti scelgo più spesso a mano?
Top {n} artisti scelti da me da una lista

computed.en: Top {n} artists by counted plays started with clickrow.
computed.it: I {n} artisti con più ascolti avviati con clickrow.

sql: SELECT a.name AS artist, COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) AS plays FROM listens l JOIN track_artists ta ON ta.track_id = l.track_id JOIN artists a ON a.id = ta.artist_id WHERE l.counted = 1 AND l.reason_start = 'clickrow' GROUP BY a.id ORDER BY plays DESC, a.name ASC LIMIT {n}

en: Where do my listens come from?
Plays by data source
it: Da dove arrivano i miei ascolti?
Ascolti per fonte dei dati

computed.en: Counted plays per observation source; a play seen by two sources counts in both.
computed.it: Ascolti conteggiati per fonte; un ascolto visto da due fonti conta in entrambe.

sql: SELECT s.value AS source, COUNT(*) AS plays FROM listens l, json_each(l.sources) s WHERE l.counted = 1 GROUP BY s.value ORDER BY plays DESC, source ASC

en: How many plays came from {source_en}?
Plays recorded by {source_en}
it: Quanti ascolti provengono da {source_it}?
Ascolti registrati da {source_it}

computed.en: Counted plays observed by source {source}.
computed.it: Ascolti conteggiati osservati dalla fonte {source}.

sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS plays FROM listens l WHERE l.counted = 1 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM json_each(l.sources) WHERE value = '{source}')

en: How many listens are waiting for duplicate review?
Possible duplicates still to review
it: Quanti ascolti aspettano la revisione dei duplicati?
Possibili duplicati ancora da rivedere

computed.en: Listens flagged as possible duplicates.
computed.it: Ascolti segnalati come possibili duplicati.

sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS listens FROM listens WHERE needs_review = 1

en: Compare {artist} and {artist2}
Who have I listened to more, {artist} or {artist2}?
it: Confronta {artist} e {artist2}
Chi ho ascoltato di più, {artist} o {artist2}?

computed.en: Counted plays for {artist} and {artist2}.
computed.it: Ascolti conteggiati di {artist} e {artist2}.

sql: SELECT a.name AS artist, COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) AS plays FROM listens l JOIN track_artists ta ON ta.track_id = l.track_id JOIN artists a ON a.id = ta.artist_id WHERE l.counted = 1 AND LOWER(a.name) IN (LOWER('{artist}'), LOWER('{artist2}')) GROUP BY a.id ORDER BY plays DESC, a.name ASC

en: Compare {year} and {year2}
Did I listen more in {year} or {year2}?
it: Confronta il {year} e il {year2}
Ho ascoltato di più nel {year} o nel {year2}?

computed.en: Counted plays and known listening time in {year} and {year2}.
computed.it: Ascolti conteggiati e tempo noto nel {year} e nel {year2}.

sql: SELECT CAST(local_year AS TEXT) AS year, COUNT(*) AS plays, SUM(listened_ms) AS listened_ms FROM listens WHERE counted = 1 AND local_year IN ({year}, {year2}) GROUP BY local_year ORDER BY local_year ASC

en: Which songs did I play more than once on the same day in {year}?
Same-day repeats in {year}
it: Quali canzoni ho ascoltato più di una volta nello stesso giorno nel {year}?
Ripetizioni nello stesso giorno nel {year}

computed.en: Tracks with two or more counted plays on one day in {year}.
computed.it: Brani con due o più ascolti conteggiati nello stesso giorno nel {year}.

sql: SELECT t.title AS track, l.local_date AS day, COUNT(*) AS plays FROM listens l JOIN tracks t ON t.id = l.track_id WHERE l.counted = 1 AND l.local_year = {year} GROUP BY t.id, l.local_date HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ORDER BY plays DESC, l.local_date ASC, track ASC LIMIT 100

en: How many new artists did I discover in {year}?
Artists first played in {year}
it: Quanti nuovi artisti ho scoperto nel {year}?
Artisti ascoltati per la prima volta nel {year}

computed.en: Artists whose first counted play is in {year}.
computed.it: Artisti con il primo ascolto conteggiato nel {year}.

sql: WITH firsts AS (SELECT ta.artist_id, MIN(l.local_date) AS first_day FROM listens l JOIN track_artists ta ON ta.track_id = l.track_id WHERE l.counted = 1 GROUP BY ta.artist_id) SELECT COUNT(*) AS artists FROM firsts WHERE first_day >= '{year}-01-01' AND first_day < '{year_next}-01-01'

en: How many artists I first played in {year} did I still play in {year2}?
Artists discovered in {year} that I kept listening to in {year2}
it: Quanti artisti ascoltati per la prima volta nel {year} ho ascoltato ancora nel {year2}?
Artisti scoperti nel {year} che ho continuato ad ascoltare nel {year2}

computed.en: Artists first played in {year} with a counted play in {year2}.
computed.it: Artisti ascoltati per la prima volta nel {year} con un ascolto nel {year2}.

sql: WITH artist_span AS (SELECT a.id, MIN(l.local_date) AS first_day FROM listens l JOIN track_artists ta ON ta.track_id = l.track_id JOIN artists a ON a.id = ta.artist_id WHERE l.counted = 1 GROUP BY a.id) SELECT COUNT(*) AS artists FROM artist_span s WHERE s.first_day >= '{year}-01-01' AND s.first_day < '{year_next}-01-01' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM listens l JOIN track_artists ta ON ta.track_id = l.track_id WHERE ta.artist_id = s.id AND l.counted = 1 AND l.local_year = {year2})

en: Which artists did I love but haven't played since {year}?
Artists I stopped listening to after {year}
it: Quali artisti amavo ma non ascolto più dal {year}?
Artisti che ho smesso di ascoltare dopo il {year}

computed.en: Most played artists whose last counted play is in {year} or earlier.
computed.it: Artisti più ascoltati con l'ultimo ascolto nel {year} o prima.

sql: SELECT a.name AS artist, COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) AS plays, MAX(l.local_date) AS last_day FROM listens l JOIN track_artists ta ON ta.track_id = l.track_id JOIN artists a ON a.id = ta.artist_id WHERE l.counted = 1 GROUP BY a.id HAVING MAX(l.local_date) < '{year_next}-01-01' ORDER BY plays DESC, a.name ASC LIMIT {n}

en: How many artists have I only ever listened to one song from?
Artists with a single song in my history
it: Di quanti artisti ho ascoltato una sola canzone?
Artisti con un solo brano nella mia cronologia

computed.en: Artists whose counted plays cover exactly one song.
computed.it: Artisti i cui ascolti conteggiati riguardano un solo brano.

sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS artists FROM (SELECT ta.artist_id FROM listens l JOIN track_artists ta ON ta.track_id = l.track_id JOIN tracks t ON t.id = l.track_id WHERE l.counted = 1 GROUP BY ta.artist_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT t.edition_key) = 1)

en: What share of my plays is {artist}?
What percentage of my listening is {artist}?
it: Che quota dei miei ascolti è {artist}?
Che percentuale dei miei ascolti è di {artist}?

computed.en: Counted plays of {artist} as a percentage of all counted plays.
computed.it: Ascolti conteggiati di {artist} in percentuale su tutti gli ascolti conteggiati.

sql: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) FROM listens l JOIN track_artists ta ON ta.track_id = l.track_id JOIN artists a ON a.id = ta.artist_id WHERE l.counted = 1 AND LOWER(a.name) = LOWER('{artist}')) / NULLIF((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM listens WHERE counted = 1), 0), 2) AS share_percent

en: Top {n} artists in {year}, keeping ties
My top {n} artists in {year} including anyone tied
it: Top {n} artisti del {year}, mantenendo i pari merito
I miei {n} artisti più ascoltati nel {year} compresi i pari merito

computed.en: Artists within the top {n} positions by counted plays in {year}, ties included.
computed.it: Artisti nelle prime {n} posizioni per ascolti nel {year}, pari merito inclusi.

sql: WITH ranked AS (SELECT a.name AS name, COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) AS plays FROM listens l JOIN track_artists ta ON ta.track_id = l.track_id JOIN artists a ON a.id = ta.artist_id WHERE l.counted = 1 AND l.local_year = {year} GROUP BY a.id), positioned AS (SELECT name, plays, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY plays DESC) AS position FROM ranked) SELECT name AS artist, plays FROM positioned WHERE position <= {n} ORDER BY plays DESC, name ASC

en: What position is {artist} in my all-time ranking?
Where does {artist} rank among my artists?
it: In che posizione è {artist} nella mia classifica di sempre?
Dove si piazza {artist} tra i miei artisti?

computed.en: Rank of {artist} by counted plays among all artists.
computed.it: Posizione di {artist} per ascolti conteggiati tra tutti gli artisti.

sql: WITH ranked AS (SELECT a.name AS name, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) DESC) AS position FROM listens l JOIN track_artists ta ON ta.track_id = l.track_id JOIN artists a ON a.id = ta.artist_id WHERE l.counted = 1 GROUP BY a.id) SELECT position FROM ranked WHERE LOWER(name) = LOWER('{artist}')

en: Which songs with '{word}' in the title have I listened to?
Tracks whose title contains {word}
it: Quali canzoni con '{word}' nel titolo ho ascoltato?
Brani il cui titolo contiene {word}

computed.en: Tracks whose title contains '{word}', by counted plays.
computed.it: Brani il cui titolo contiene '{word}', per ascolti conteggiati.

sql: SELECT t.title AS track, COUNT(*) AS plays FROM listens l JOIN tracks t ON t.id = l.track_id WHERE l.counted = 1 AND LOWER(t.title) LIKE '%' || LOWER('{word}') || '%' GROUP BY t.id ORDER BY plays DESC, t.title ASC LIMIT 50

en: Show every day of {month_en} {year} with its plays, including days with none
Daily plays for {month_en} {year}
it: Mostra ogni giorno di {month_it} {year} con i suoi ascolti, anche quelli senza
Ascolti giornalieri di {month_it} {year}

computed.en: Counted plays per calendar day of {month_en} {year}, zero when silent.
computed.it: Ascolti conteggiati per giorno di {month_it} {year}, zero se nessuno.

sql: SELECT c.local_date AS day, COUNT(l.id) AS plays FROM calendar c LEFT JOIN listens l ON l.local_date = c.local_date AND l.counted = 1 WHERE c.year = {year} AND c.month = {month} GROUP BY c.local_date ORDER BY c.local_date ASC

en: On how many {weekday_en}s in {year} did I listen to nothing?
Silent {weekday_en}s in {year}
it: In quanti {weekday_it} del {year} non ho ascoltato niente?
{weekday_it} senza musica nel {year}

computed.en: {weekday_en}s of {year} in the archive range without counted plays.
computed.it: {weekday_it} del {year} nell'archivio senza ascolti conteggiati.

sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS days FROM calendar c WHERE c.year = {year} AND c.weekday = {weekday} AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM listens l WHERE l.local_date = c.local_date AND l.counted = 1)

en: For each week of {month_en} {year}, on how many days did I listen?
Active days per week in {month_en} {year}
it: Per ogni settimana di {month_it} {year}, in quanti giorni ho ascoltato?
Giorni attivi per settimana a {month_it} {year}

computed.en: Days with counted plays per calendar week in {month_en} {year}.
computed.it: Giorni con ascolti conteggiati per settimana a {month_it} {year}.

sql: SELECT c.week_date AS week, COUNT(DISTINCT l.local_date) AS days_with_music FROM calendar c LEFT JOIN listens l ON l.local_date = c.local_date AND l.counted = 1 WHERE c.year = {year} AND c.month = {month} GROUP BY c.week_date ORDER BY c.week_date ASC

en: How many songs do I listen to on the first day of each month?
Plays on the 1st of the month
it: Quante canzoni ascolto il primo giorno di ogni mese?
Ascolti del primo del mese

computed.en: Counted plays on calendar days numbered 1.
computed.it: Ascolti conteggiati nei giorni 1 del mese.

sql: SELECT COUNT(l.id) AS plays FROM calendar c JOIN listens l ON l.local_date = c.local_date AND l.counted = 1 WHERE c.day = 1

en: Which timezone and week start does my archive use?
What calendar settings are my stats computed with?
it: Quale fuso orario e inizio settimana usa il mio archivio?
Con quali impostazioni di calendario sono calcolate le statistiche?

computed.en: Configured timezone and week start (0 = Monday).
computed.it: Fuso orario e inizio settimana configurati (0 = lunedì).

sql: SELECT timezone, week_start FROM meta

en: How up to date is the data you are answering from?
When was the Ask data last rebuilt?
it: Quanto sono aggiornati i dati da cui rispondi?
Quando sono stati ricostruiti l'ultima volta i dati di Ask?

computed.en: Archive revision and build time of the Ask projection.
computed.it: Revisione dell'archivio e ora di costruzione della proiezione Ask.

sql: SELECT revision, built_at_ms AS built_at FROM meta

en: With which week start were my listens assigned?
How many listens per assigned week start?
it: Con quale inizio settimana sono stati assegnati i miei ascolti?
Quanti ascolti per inizio settimana assegnato?

computed.en: Listens grouped by their assigned week start (0 = Monday).
computed.it: Ascolti raggruppati per inizio settimana assegnato (0 = lunedì).

sql: SELECT week_start, COUNT(*) AS listens FROM listens GROUP BY week_start ORDER BY week_start ASC

en: How many different tracks of {artist} are in my archive?
Number of {artist} tracks I have
it: Quanti brani diversi di {artist} ho nell'archivio?
Numero di brani di {artist} che ho

computed.en: Distinct track ids credited to {artist}.
computed.it: Brani distinti accreditati a {artist}.

sql: SELECT a.name AS artist, COUNT(DISTINCT ta.track_id) AS tracks FROM artists a JOIN track_artists ta ON ta.artist_id = a.id WHERE LOWER(a.name) = LOWER('{artist}') GROUP BY a.id ORDER BY tracks DESC, a.name ASC

en: What is the weather today?
Tell me a joke
Who won the last World Cup?
it: Che tempo fa oggi?
Raccontami una barzelletta
Chi ha vinto l'ultimo mondiale?

computed.en: I can only answer questions about your listening history.
computed.it: Posso rispondere solo a domande sulla tua cronologia di ascolto.

en: Delete all my plays of {artist}
Rename {artist} to something else
Add a play of {track} for today
it: Cancella tutti i miei ascolti di {artist}
Rinomina {artist} in qualcos'altro
Aggiungi un ascolto di {track} per oggi

computed.en: Ask is read-only: it cannot change your archive.
computed.it: Ask è di sola lettura: non può modificare il tuo archivio.

en: Which genre do I listen to most?
How many podcasts did I listen to?
What's the BPM of my favourite song?
it: Quale genere ascolto di più?
Quanti podcast ho ascoltato?
Quanti BPM ha la mia canzone preferita?

computed.en: Your archive has no data for this: genres, podcasts and audio features are not recorded.
computed.it: L'archivio non ha dati per questo: generi, podcast e caratteristiche audio non sono registrati.
